recommendation_summary: Wrap the cron command so any non-zero exit emails the traceback, write a success stamp to a shared folder, and add a DSM Task Scheduler job on the Synology at 03:30 that emails if the stamp is not from today; renew the token separately.

labels.Requirements and who asked: Same-morning notice when nightly-sync does not finish. You asked. A central log and Docker were an approach you suggested.
labels.Deleted: A log collector, a Docker stack, and moving the job. A log sits unread, and it never raises an alarm by itself.
labels.Bottleneck: Silence. The script emails only after it gets through startup, so the expired token ended the run with no mail, and no mail looks like a quiet night.
labels.Checked myself: What you told me. One Python cron at 03:00 on edna, a summary email only when it finishes, four startup crashes from an expired token, no other alert, and a Synology that can run containers. I have not looked at either machine.

note: It recommends two separate alerting mechanisms (a failure email wrapper and a Synology-hosted stamp check), which makes it LARGER even though it rejects the log and Docker stack.
